blockingFindings.title: Action/detail screens still use low-contrast repeated utility shells
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Create readable, domain-native action/detail surfaces for the affected workflows. Use opaque surface colors with accessible contrast, screen-specific layout, real domain objects and inputs, explicit primary/secondary/lifecycle actions, and visible result/receiver states; then full recapture B12-B20 evidence.

blockingFindings.title: Workflow/persona product experience remains too generic on sixteen workflows
blockingFindings.requiredFix: For each blocking workflow/persona pair, implement a surface that makes the target persona real job obvious: object context, user inputs/decision data, primary action, alternative/change/reject/cancel path, result/receipt/history, and receiver/continuation state.

blockingFindings.title: Six workflows still lack visible persistent result/lifecycle proof
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Add visible post-action result/receipt/status/history/receiver states to the affected workflows and recapture start/action/result rows proving those states.

blockingFindings.title: Workflow lifecycle UX is incomplete
blockingFindings.requiredFix: Use the failed lifecycle scorecards to add concrete objects, decision information, semantic primary and alternate actions, persistent result state, and receiver/continuation state before recapturing evidence.
